svg.title: Promote a revision across separate Applications
svg.desc: Illustrative Git promotion. DEV, STG and PROD Application records live on the management cluster and each routes to its own target. Staging verification Jobs probe DEV before staging deploys SHA 9f3a2c1. Production verification Jobs probe STG. Production candidate 9f3a2c1 waits for manual approval while accepted revision 7d41f02 stays deployed. Jobs execute in the management cluster, not between remote clusters; no artifact is transferred.
svg.text: Promote a revision across separate Applications
Each environment keeps its own configuration and deployment target.
PAPRIKA MANAGEMENT CLUSTER / APPLICATION RECORDS + VERIFICATION JOBS
Dotted probes run from management Jobs to upstream environments. PROD waits for candidate-specific approval.
